structural_evidence.interpretation: Local joint structural-state intervention changes strict tracked-pair continuation in the selected high-compression regime. Does not isolate which state component or establish a history-dependent interaction law.
structural_evidence.reporting_discrepancy: Historical prose says medians 22/5/22; archived raw and summary agree on 21/4.5/21. Its p=0.000106 matches a one-sided less test; sidedness was unspecified.

vortex_evidence.interpretation: Persistent topological object class and survival under the tested smooth core perturbation; nonsignificant difference is not a formal equivalence proof or autonomy claim.

forecast_evidence.interpretation: Replicated relational predictive information, below the original object-level gate. No independent object dynamics or general interaction law established.

net_torque_cancellation.conclusion: grad_align is magnitude of net alignment torque, not total disagreement or energy.

fixed_sign_drive.conclusion: Compression rule adds +0.1*tau angular drive; for nonnegative tau a turning sign is supplied, not spontaneously selected.

dt_convention.conclusion: Structural recurrences are per-update while theta uses dt. Physical-time convergence requires an explicit convention; naive dt halving is not such a test.

compression_semantics.conclusion: C emphasizes near-zero determinant and is sign-insensitive, not a general pressure or physical energy density.
